description_en: Queries the events of an AI task
kebab_example: aliyun ros list-ai-task-events --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000w== --max-results 50 --task-id t-asasas00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAITaskEvents

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of results to be returned from a single query when the NextToken parameter is used in the query.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh:
使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI task
parameters.name: task_id

AgentType.description_en:
The type of the agent that is used to execute the AI task.

Valid values:

GenerateTemplateAgent
FixUserTemplateAgent

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the event was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，需使用UTC时间，格式：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

EstimatedProcessingTime.description_en: The estimated execution time of the handler. Unit: seconds
EstimatedProcessingTime.description_zh: 当前Handler预估执行时间。单位：秒

HandlerProcessStatus.description_en:
The execution state of the handler that process the AI task.

Valid values:

SUCCESS
RUNNING
FAILURE

HandlerType.description_en:
The type of the handler that is used to execute the task.

Valid values:

TerraformTemplateGenerator
TemplateGenerator
ROSTemplateModifier
TerraformTemplateStaticFixer
TerraformTemplateDynamicFixer
DocumentTemplateGenerator
TerraformTemplateModifier
TemplateModifier
FixTemplateInputPreprocessor
TemplateStaticFixer
GenerateTemplateInputPreprocessor
ROSTemplateGenerator
TemplateDynamicFixer
BaseDynamicFixer
ROSTemplateStaticFixer
ROSTemplateDynamicFixer

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists
NextToken.description_zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
NextToken.title_en: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
NextToken.title_zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the AI task

TaskStatus.description_en:
The state of the AI task.

PENDING
WAITING
RUNNING
SUCCESS
FAILURE
TaskStatus.description_zh:
AI任务当前的状态：

PENDING
WAITING
RUNNING
SUCCESS
FAILURE

TaskType.description_en:
The type of the AI task.

GenerateTemplate: The AI task is used to generate a template.
FixTemplate: The AI task is used to fix a template
TaskType.description_zh:
AI任务的类型。
GenerateTemplate：AI生成模板
FixTemplate：AI模板修复
